transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I... well, I guess I'm here because things have been getting weird lately. At work and school. I've been doing things that... don't really make sense. Like, I'll catch myself lining up receipts all across the floor at the office, or tapping the calculator... always in sets of nine. And sometimes I just... I don't know, I stand by the copier with my hands up in the air. I don't even realize I'm doing it until someone walks by and asks if I'm okay.
Before you do these movements or tapping, do you feel a strong urge or buildup of tension that gets relieved when you do them?
No, I don't think so. I just... do it. I don't really feel anything before it happens.
Do you ever make any sounds or vocal noises that you can’t control, like sniffing, grunting, throat clearing, or repeating words?
No... I haven't noticed anything like that. Just the tapping and the... the standing. No noises.
Can you hold back these movements if you try, even for a short time?
I don't know... I haven't really tried. Like I said, I don't always know I'm doing it until I'm already doing it. So... I guess I haven't tried to stop it.
Before you start lining things up or doing the tapping, do you get unwanted thoughts or images that make you feel you have to do it?
No... I don't think so. There aren't any thoughts or... pictures in my head. Like I said, it just happens.
Before these movements happen, do you feel a sudden urge or pressure that builds up and then feels better after you do them?
No... not really. I don't feel any... pressure or anything like that. I just do it.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to notice?

...Um. I guess... sometimes. Like, if I'm just sitting by myself at my desk... or walking home. I'll hear... a guy's voice. He just says stuff like, um, "check line seven" or "you missed the sign." It sounds like someone's right there, so I look around, but... there's nobody around. That's all.
When you hear that voice, does it seem like it is coming from outside your head, as if someone is really speaking nearby?
Yeah... it sounds like it's coming from outside. Like someone is just... standing right next to me. That's why I look around. But, um... no one's there.
When you hear that voice, do you believe it is actually a real person speaking nearby?
Um... I don't know. I guess... sometimes I think it is, but then I look and... no one's there. So... I'm not sure.
Do you think the lining up, tapping, and standing in those positions are something you choose to do, or do they feel like they happen on their own?

Um... I don't know. I guess I choose to do it. It's just... I started doing these things at work, like lining the receipts all across the floor. Or... I'll tap the calculator, like, nine times in a row. And sometimes I just stand by the copier with my hands up... until someone asks if I'm okay. I don't really know why I do it. It just... doesn't make sense, I guess.
When these things happen, do you ever lose track of what you're doing or feel like you’re in a trance?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I just... I know what I'm doing when I do it. I just don't know why.
Do the movements ever feel sudden and jerky, like a tic, rather than like a deliberate action?
Um... no. Not really. It's... it's not like that. I just do it.
When you do the lining up, tapping, or standing with your hands up, do you feel like you’re choosing to do it, or does it happen without you being able to control it?

Um... I think I just choose to do it. Like I said, I just... I do these things that don't make sense. Like the receipts on the floor, or the tapping the calculator nine times... or just standing by the copier with my hands up. I can control it, I guess. I just... do it.
Before you do the lining up, tapping, or standing, do you get unwanted thoughts, images, or fears that make you feel you have to do them?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get any thoughts or anything like that. I just... do it.
When you do the lining up, tapping, or standing in place, do you feel like you have to do them to prevent something bad from happening?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think about anything bad happening. I'm not trying to prevent anything. It's just... something I do.
When you hear the voice, do you think it might be your mind playing tricks on you, or does it seem completely real?

I don't know... it seems real. When I'm alone at my desk, or walking home, I'll hear this man's voice. He says things like... "check line seven" or "you missed the sign." It's clear. I usually look around, but... nobody's there.
When you hear that voice, does it sound like it's coming from inside your head or from outside, like a real person in the room?
Um... outside. Like I said, I always look around for whoever said it. It just... sounds like a real person standing right near me.
Do you ever find yourself doing these movements or postures even when you try very hard not to?
I haven't really... tried to stop. I just do it. I don't really think about it that much.
When you hear the man's voice, does it feel like it is heard with your ears, as if it were really in the room?
I don't know... I guess so. I just hear it. I don't really pay attention to... how my ears feel. Like I said, it just sounds like he's there.
When you hear the man's voice, does it sound like it is coming from outside your head, as if someone is really speaking in the room?

Yeah... I mean, like I just said, it's outside. Like if I'm just sitting alone at my desk, or... walking home. I'll hear him say stuff. Like 'check line seven' or... 'you missed the sign.' It's clear enough that I always look around to see who said it. But... nobody's there.
